shared_files_minimal.tools/i6dmo/__init__.py: one-line docstring only; any lane may create it with identical content

consumed_hooks.tools.i6dmo.contracts.validate_design(de: model lane; must return {ok: bool, errors: [str], design_sha256: str}; pure
consumed_hooks.tools.i6dmo.contracts.effective_config(d: model lane; sealed effective config; ops adds pins and seals with sha256
consumed_hooks.child entry argv per unit kind: configured in EFFECTIVE_CONFIG.ops.entrypoints {fit, report, pair, final_refit, final_test}; default python -m tools.i6dmo.<training|reporting|strategy> run-unit

child_protocol.UNIT_SPEC.json: unit_id, kind, family, stage, cadence, identity, identity_sha256, effective_config (sealed), upstream terminals {unit_id: {path, sha256}}, device {class, gpu_uuid}, cap_bytes, test_open (false except final_test after readiness)
child_protocol.progress.json: {done:int, total:int|null, unit:'epoch'|'batch'|'row'|..., phase:'fit'|'score'|'publish', updated_at: epoch seconds} rewritten atomically

out/TERMINAL.json.artifacts: {name: {path: relative to out, sha256}}  (best checkpoint, predictions, per-head masks/counts)
out/TERMINAL.json.eligibility: report units: {horizon_hours(str): {mae, naive, eligible: bool, n}}
out/TERMINAL.json.reports: list of governed OLAP reports (predictor_olap_store.query.normalise_report schema); ops enqueues them in the outbox

child_protocol.exit_codes: 0 terminal written; nonzero = FAILED (137 -> FAILED_OOM, 124 -> FAILED_TIMEOUT); never retried with a smaller cap

private_deployment_spec: see tools/i6dmo/deploy.py PRIVATE_SPEC_DOC; JSON with roles -> {ssh_alias|null for local, gpus [{class, uuid, heavy, parallel_slot}], data_root, run_root, python, workdir}, warehouse {url, environment_file, token_env}, mirrors {local, second_host_role, second_host_path}, launcher {crispdm_run, initial_cap_bytes, wall_seconds}. Never committed.
